name: fair enough
trans: phr. 有道理；说得也是
example: Fair enough, let's try your idea first and compare results.
exampleTrans: 有道理，我们先试试你的想法，再比较结果。

name: sounds good
trans: phr. 听起来不错
example: Sounds good, I'll meet you outside the theater at seven.
exampleTrans: 听起来不错，我七点在剧院外面等你。

name: that makes sense
trans: phr. 这说得通
example: That makes sense, especially after you explained the local custom.
exampleTrans: 这说得通，尤其是在你解释了当地习俗之后。

name: I agree
trans: phr. 我同意
example: I agree, the second plan sounds much more practical.
exampleTrans: 我同意，第二个计划听起来实际得多。

name: I don't think so
trans: phr. 我不这么认为
example: I don't think so, but I'm happy to hear your reasons.
exampleTrans: 我不这么认为，但我愿意听听你的理由。

name: not really
trans: phr. 不完全是；不太是
example: Not really, I usually prefer quiet weekends at home.
exampleTrans: 不太是，我通常更喜欢安静地在家过周末。

name: it depends
trans: phr. 视情况而定
example: It depends on the weather and everyone's schedule.
exampleTrans: 这要看天气和大家的日程。

name: of course
trans: adv. 当然
example: Of course, you can bring your roommate to the party.
exampleTrans: 当然，你可以带室友来参加聚会。

name: probably
trans: adv. 大概；很可能
example: Probably, but I'll check my calendar before confirming.
exampleTrans: 大概可以，但我确认前要先看看日历。

name: absolutely
trans: adv. 当然；完全地
example: Absolutely, that was the funniest story I've heard all week.
exampleTrans: 当然，那是我这周听过最好笑的故事。

name: exactly
trans: adv. 正是如此
example: Exactly, that's what I meant about respecting local customs.
exampleTrans: 正是如此，这就是我所说的尊重当地习俗。

name: you bet
trans: int. 当然；没问题
example: You bet, I'd love to join the hiking trip.
exampleTrans: 当然，我很乐意参加这次徒步旅行。

name: why not
trans: int. 为什么不呢
example: Why not, we still have plenty of time before dinner.
exampleTrans: 为什么不呢，晚饭前我们还有很多时间。

name: maybe another time
trans: phr. 也许下次吧
example: Maybe another time; I already have plans this evening.
exampleTrans: 也许下次吧，我今晚已经有安排了。

name: I'm afraid so
trans: phr. 恐怕是这样
example: I'm afraid so, the outdoor concert has been canceled.
exampleTrans: 恐怕是这样，露天音乐会已经取消了。

name: I'm afraid not
trans: phr. 恐怕不行
example: I'm afraid not, we're leaving early tomorrow morning.
exampleTrans: 恐怕不行，我们明天一早就要出发。

name: never mind
trans: phr. 没关系；别在意
example: Never mind, we can choose a different restaurant nearby.
exampleTrans: 没关系，我们可以选附近另一家餐厅。

name: my bad
trans: int. 我的错
example: My bad, I thought the party started at eight.
exampleTrans: 我的错，我以为聚会八点开始。

name: no worries
trans: phr. 没关系；不用担心
example: No worries, everyone gets lost here the first time.
exampleTrans: 没关系，大家第一次来这里都会迷路。

name: that's okay
trans: phr. 没关系
example: That's okay, we can talk again when you're less busy.
exampleTrans: 没关系，等你不那么忙时我们再聊。

name: excuse me
trans: int. 劳驾；对不起
example: Excuse me, is anyone sitting in this seat?
exampleTrans: 劳驾，这个座位有人坐吗？

name: I'm sorry
trans: phr. 对不起
example: I'm sorry, I completely forgot about our lunch plan.
exampleTrans: 对不起，我完全忘了我们的午餐计划。

name: thank you
trans: int. 谢谢你
example: Thank you for introducing me to your friends.
exampleTrans: 谢谢你把我介绍给你的朋友们。

name: thanks a lot
trans: int. 非常感谢
example: Thanks a lot for helping me practice the pronunciation.
exampleTrans: 非常感谢你帮助我练习发音。

name: you're welcome
trans: int. 不客气
example: You're welcome; I'm glad the directions were helpful.
exampleTrans: 不客气，我很高兴那些路线说明有帮助。

name: I appreciate it
trans: phr. 我很感激
example: I appreciate it; your advice made the conversation much easier.
exampleTrans: 我很感激，你的建议让这次交谈轻松多了。

name: would you mind
trans: phr. 你介意吗
example: Would you mind speaking a little more slowly?
exampleTrans: 你介意说得稍微慢一点吗？

name: could you please
trans: phr. 请问你能否
example: Could you please repeat the name of that festival?
exampleTrans: 请问你能再说一遍那个节日的名字吗？

name: go ahead
trans: phr. 请吧；继续吧
example: Go ahead, I'd like to hear the rest of your story.
exampleTrans: 继续吧，我想听完你的故事。

name: after you
trans: phr. 您先请
example: After you, there's only enough room for one person.
exampleTrans: 您先请，这里只够一个人通过。

name: by the way
trans: phr. 顺便说一下
example: By the way, are you free this weekend?
exampleTrans: 顺便问一下，你这周末有空吗？

name: to be honest
trans: phr. 说实话
example: To be honest, I didn't enjoy the movie very much.
exampleTrans: 说实话，我不太喜欢那部电影。

name: as far as I know
trans: phr. 据我所知
example: As far as I know, the museum is free on Fridays.
exampleTrans: 据我所知，那家博物馆周五免费。

name: you know
trans: int. 你知道的；那个
example: You know, the weather here changes incredibly quickly.
exampleTrans: 你知道的，这里的天气变化特别快。

name: I mean
trans: int. 我的意思是
example: I mean, we could stay home if it keeps raining.
exampleTrans: 我的意思是，如果一直下雨，我们可以待在家。

name: let me think
trans: phr. 让我想想
example: Let me think, I might have met her at college.
exampleTrans: 让我想想，我可能在大学见过她。

name: guess what
trans: int. 你猜怎么着
example: Guess what, my cousin is visiting us next month.
exampleTrans: 你猜怎么着，我表亲下个月要来看我们。

name: believe it or not
trans: phr. 信不信由你
example: Believe it or not, we attended the same primary school.
exampleTrans: 信不信由你，我们上过同一所小学。

name: what do you mean
trans: phr. 你是什么意思
example: What do you mean when you call the neighborhood lively?
exampleTrans: 你说这个社区很热闹是什么意思？

name: how about you
trans: phr. 你呢
example: I enjoy photography; how about you and your hobbies?
exampleTrans: 我喜欢摄影，你呢，你有什么爱好？

name: me too
trans: int. 我也是
example: Me too, I always feel happier near the ocean.
exampleTrans: 我也是，我在海边总觉得更快乐。

name: me neither
trans: int. 我也不
example: Me neither, crowded parties make me feel exhausted.
exampleTrans: 我也不喜欢，拥挤的聚会让我筋疲力尽。

name: not bad
trans: phr. 还不错
example: Not bad, considering I only started learning last month.
exampleTrans: 还不错，毕竟我上个月才开始学。

name: pretty much
trans: adv. 差不多；几乎
example: Pretty much, although we still disagree about the ending.
exampleTrans: 差不多吧，尽管我们对结局仍有分歧。

name: kind of
trans: adv. 有点儿
example: Kind of, but I'm more tired than bored.
exampleTrans: 有点儿，但与其说无聊，不如说我更累。

name: not at all
trans: phr. 一点也不；不用谢
example: Not at all, I was happy to help with your luggage.
exampleTrans: 一点也不麻烦，我很乐意帮你拿行李。

name: that's great
trans: int. 那太好了
example: That's great, congratulations on finishing your language course.
exampleTrans: 那太好了，恭喜你完成语言课程。

name: what a shame
trans: int. 真遗憾
example: What a shame, the festival ended before we arrived.
exampleTrans: 真遗憾，我们到达前节日活动就结束了。

name: what a surprise
trans: int. 真让人惊讶
example: What a surprise, I didn't expect to see you here.
exampleTrans: 真让人惊讶，我没想到会在这里见到你。

name: lucky you
trans: int. 你真幸运
example: Lucky you, the weather stayed sunny throughout your holiday.
exampleTrans: 你真幸运，整个假期天气都很晴朗。
